notes.title: Christmas Event!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/3649fef3781ef18de21351a2394cb6a455e7904e.png[/img]
In case you missed it last year, the Holiday Events loop every year!
Starting on December 1st, unwrap the floating Christmas Presents to earn bonus Weapon Cubes, Time Cubes, Maximum Damage & Gold. This limited time event ends on January 5.

[h1]Presents[/h1]
Presents will appear around the Turret every 5 - 10 minutes.
They will float around for 30 seconds before disappearing.
Collect Presents by shooting them, using the free roam camera or manually collecting them.

[b]Blue Present = Time Cubes[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/31e342860f38e467e1509071872dd57dd5ee0865.png[/img]
This present only appears after completing your very first Time Warp.
Each present will give you the Time Cubes Per Zone x Multipliers / 4.

[b]Green Present = Weapon Cubes[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/d90cb275dd023e4f268b9499e67d702b28d98fcb.png[/img]
This present only appears after you've collected your very first Weapon Cubes.
Each present will give you Weapon Cubes Per Zone x Multipliers / 4.

[b]White Present = Maximum Damage[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/849a777e82bdeb38de04bbf1f552eeb7d6002eb2.png[/img]
This present appears as long as you have bought at least one Active Ability on your current timeline.
Each present will give you bonus Energy based on your Maximum Damage Research.

[b]Yellow Present = Gold[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/5ab2020ab4444f75f1e2839defc47b5a38a3647a.png[/img]
These presents can always appear and will give you your Gold Per Min x 5.

[h1]Outfits[/h1]
Collecting Presents also unlocks permanent holiday Outfits.

[b]Soldier & Hover Bike [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/7fb052bb85b23a636ab33b3b87ea2a996d9d86c2.png[/img]
Hover Bike Outfits are attached to the selected Soldier skin so.......
Select the Soldier's Elf Outfit to use the Reindeer Hover Bike.
Select the Soldier's Santa Outfit to switch to the Hover Bike Sleigh.

[b]Drone[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/e514e85e202bec01892499a4f5c5f36a4eb0d876.png[/img]

[b]Turret[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/e00f38eb7dbe6cbb306645ccf3099909af996f16.png[/img]

[h1]Christmas Missions[/h1]
All of the Christmas Event Missions can be found in the Holiday Achievements screen.

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Halloween Event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/f3d374213101c15a790424340430a05a9f73376e.png[/img]
[h1]Halloween Event[/h1]
In case you missed it last year, the Holiday Events loop every year! 
Starting on October 1st,  Zones 1-100 will be filled with candy & pumpkins. 
Collect Candy, launch it at Pumpkins to upgrade & unlock permanent Halloween costumes for the Soldier, Drone & Turret.
The Halloween Event will start at 12:00 am MST, and run through October 31.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/f6723d49214a0f0d6e1b03978016265a8ab4bc07.png[/img]
[h1]Candy Pickups[/h1]
There are 9 candies per Zone. 
Collected candies respawn every minute.
Collect candies by actively running around, using the Free Roam Camera, or idly sitting on one. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/02c9c1113fe659abb8bf9cb51d010d47f09365a5.png[/img]
Or unlock the Candy Magnet and let the candies come to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/c36dada96d973b6ee6d96abef43aa473e7e2ce3c.png[/img]
[h1]Candy Launcher[/h1]
Once unlocked, the Candy Launcher can be used to blast candies at Pumpkins for rewards. 
The Candy Launcher is exclusively for the Soldier (Drone or Turret can't equip it). 
You'll definitely want to use your Automatic Fire & Dual Wield Abilities, but just a heads up, Perks & Critical shots are disabled on the Candy Launcher. 
To equip it, hover over the Soldier & select it from the Weapon Types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/f37d8b57b3a45a3f0104bf94e75efb43d2f0c14e.png[/img]
[h1]Candy Launcher UI[/h1]
When the Candy Launcher is equipped the Soldier info changes to show all the important Halloween event stats. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/a00a1d0442e9d6614ab988e373ef1712f0bc941c.png[/img]
[h1]Candy Per Click Pumpkin[/h1]
This pumpkin increases how many candies the Candy Launcher fires with one click. 
Find the Candy Per Click Pumpkin in Zones 10, 40 & 70.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/85e89c3590f4e56cc6c806e6925da81ef95e38ce.png[/img]
[h1]Candy Per Pickup Pumpkin[/h1]
This pumpkin increases how many candies you get with each piece of candy you collect. 
Find the Candy Per Pickup Pumpkin in Zones 20, 50 & 80.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/44087f134a3e62bdf895ba3a274d6355ee95073d.png[/img]
[h1]Candy Magnet Pumpkin[/h1]
This pumpkin increases how quickly candy is pulled towards you. 
Find the Candy Magnet Pumpkin in Zones 30, 60 & 90.

[h1]Public World Pumpkins[/h1]
If there are multiple people in a Pumpkin Zone, everyone in that Zone will be credited for the candies other players feed to the Pumpkins (using your Candy Per Click stat). 
Other player's candy bullets are never hidden, so you'll always know when someone is launching candy at a pumpkin. 

[h1]Halloween Costumes[/h1]
The Soldier, Drone & Turret are getting into the Halloween spirit with unlockable permanent costumes.
Complete Missions to unlock the….
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/fe9e2bae6bf0192fd54d56c171c51a85323185ec.png[/img]
Soldier's Frankenstein & Skeleton Outfits
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/0b24d20d133f02c11d266ca42f398a696083b0b1.png[/img]
Drone's Mummy & Green Dragon Outfits
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/f8f5ec353891238a922afe7ee9ae9aba10cf4c99.png[/img]
Turret's Turtle & Red Dragon Outfits

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/4b92470abe0ac2b94870430a75a2feb1a8358669.png[/img]
[h1]Halloween Missions[/h1]
All of the Halloween Missions can be found in the Holiday Achievements screen.

notes.title: Easter Event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/c3164ffb97f714f2baca1ddee9f9103bda846c34.png[/img]
[h1]Easter Egg Hunt[/h1]
In case you missed it last year, the Holiday Events loop every year!
Zones 1-100 will be filled with colorful Easter eggs (at least 5 per zone).
Find & collect eggs to permanently unlock bunny outfits for the Soldier, Drone & Turret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/a34caed95959255b1c8ddb2628fa1e7f7cc30215.png[/img]
[h1]Holiday Achievements[/h1]
Collect 100 eggs to permanently unlock the Soldier's bunny outfit. 
Collect 500 to unlock the Drone's bunny ears and 1,000 for the Turret's ears.
Unlocks are per save profile, and outfits can only be unlocked during the Easter event.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/fe39d80f49490075062fbafc0468fe4b29d9e3a3.png[/img]
[h1]Outfits[/h1]
Change outfits by hovering over a teammate.
Hover over a teammate for the outfit selector.
Each Build Preset can have a different outfit, so you can be a speed running bunny and an idle soldier. 
Want to check out your new outfit, comma (,) is the default key to toggle 3rd person.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/7894784d750c63e8ae08d25789b66814b7867666.png[/img]
[h1]Collecting Eggs[/h1]
Active players can collect eggs by running around or using the Free Roam Camera.
Eggs respawn every minute so idle players can literally sit on an egg to collect them.

notes.title: UPDATE 23: 1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
[h3]After 23 Updates and 1 Year in Early Access Time Warpers is Now Complete![/h3]

[h1]Steam Trading Cards[/h1]
You can now start collecting Time Warpers Steam Trading Cards!

[b]Trading Cards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/eb9d1577ace626429b73a994e295df21c2b25076.png[/img]

[b]Badges[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/47ae4fa8016ea5b3ab00ab3193c84ec15ae3acaa.png[/img]
The first fives images are the standard badges. 
The Golden Clock is the Foil Badge.

[b]Backgrounds[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/080baa69ae928cbc980c64c2abab267e5891d3ff.png[/img]
The Charger, Soldier & Turret backgrounds are common drops.
The Scientist background is an uncommon drop. 
The Weapon Cube background is a rare drop. 

[b]Emoticons[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/4a23b4a28a22bb949bfaa886db2ad589612cffdf.png[/img]
The Crosshair, and 2 Hover Bike emoticons are common drops.
The Butterfly icon is an uncommon drop.
The King Card emoticon is a rare drop.

[h1]Convert Cubes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/31eb037b5abd74852b62fdd48faee5f079c27fd3.png[/img]
The Cube Converter is unlocked by completing the Collect 100 Weapon Cubes Mission. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/48a6522252b0b8af1a5d47932c7967ed89842b5a.png[/img]
Once unlocked, there will be a new Cube Converter button available when Time Warping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/0efd1955a8eeabaecbf283ca6f5c5c0265683eff.png[/img]
The Cube Converter lets you convert Time Cubes to Weapon Cubes and vice versa.
You can choose to convert  1, 10, 100, 1K, 10K, 100K, 1M, 10M, 100M or 1B Cubes.
Clicking the arrow once will convert the selected number of Cubes. 
Holding down the arrow will convert multiple of that amount (just like when buying/selling Research).

[h1]Looping Timeline Cards[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/5d161baad625003d76447832f0d125bfa0b1da43.png[/img]
Collect all 52 cards in the first Timeline Cards deck to complete the Full Deck Mission and unlock Looping Cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/2f6b0c2f472857d1f60bdea98b680b5492ca53da.png[/img]
When starting your second deck, the Show Deck screen will display Total Decks Collected as well as Total Cards Collected for your current deck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/76d6f4bdd4094db8781031d5f33ea043c7e56106.png[/img]
After the first deck is complete, the 2 and Ace cards will be disabled. The rest of cards will loop, letting you select from 44 cards.

[h1]Zone 10,000 Outfits[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/5c7386172a018ad4afe181daadea5f51d42ea535.png[/img]
Get to Zone 10,000 to complete your gold mining contract and unlock the 10K Soldier & Hover Bike Outfits.

[h1]Overpowered Music[/h1]
[previewyoutube=VD0eTsoZubs;full][/previewyoutube]
New music track added for when you're Overpowered.

[h1]Boss Music[/h1]
[previewyoutube=EPgZsDerRvc;full][/previewyoutube]
New music track added for Horde & Boss fights.

[h1]Weapon Cube Save Profile[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/27697ae53a95e37cfdbc03dcac30a99b04d98f52.png[/img]
Total Weapon Cubes is now displayed on the Save Profile screen.

[h1]Time Attack extended to 10,000[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/d7d5a4a2a26b3208ecddd6c354c832cc6178861f.png[/img]
The Stats screen displays Time Attack for Zones 50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, 5000, and 10000

[h1]Weapon Cubes Stats[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/44e88b45b69c7a172f2e7b4ce114e31e4399aff7.png[/img]
Weapon Cubes have added to the Stat screen.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
- Fixed Christmas Presents spawning outside the Christmas Event
- Added ability for Mods to unstick stuck Zones
- Removed Early Access branding from Settings Bar

notes.title: UPDATE 21: Top Voted Ideas
notes.notes:
This update was all about implementing some of the top voted ideas from our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/N4G2mZ9]Discord Ideas Channel[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/2dcf72daef88f60377189eb411363fb295224beb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/4e8be2ceaf7f51e4f71ce8690c663e327320665a.png[/img]
This new Time Cube & Weapon Cube Research lets you increase the Click Weapon maximum energy from 100 up to 300.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637666/2e3a424ba5a0ad153083b4e947a6dedb89929033.png[/img]
The Zone HP bar will change to a rainbow when fighting a Rainbow Wave of enemies.

Clicking on a player in the Live Leaderboard gives you the option of teleporting to the health station near that player.

https://imgur.com/a/2qOmOGB (Gif)

notes.title: UPDATE 19: Card Automation
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/710527cc0df2164f14bf4191fc4a3ef37a2103c7.png[/img]
[h1]Auto Select Cards[/h1]
Auto Select Cards will automatically choose cards based on the priority you set.
You'll need to collect all '4 of a Kind' for each Card to unlock the ability to Auto Select that Card.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/1ac52528ca794b13aca8c593ad15b7bc9141b49d.png[/img]
[h1]Auto Select Cards Mission[/h1]
The Auto Select Cards screen is locked until the 'Collect Any 4 of a Kind' Mission is completed.
This Mission becomes active as soon as you choose your first Card.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/6d100267966aa947d1e76e614e18eb704624c27e.png[/img]
[h1]Auto Select Cards Priority[/h1]
There are two steps for setting Card priority:
Step 1: Select the Card you want to set the priority for
Step 2: Select the position you want that Card to be in
This will swap the first selected Card with the second one.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/03cddd6dd015133a37bd82f2ea2ba1a4a1d06110.png[/img]
[h1]Weapon Cube Damage Research[/h1]
The Weapon Cube Damage Research makes it so each Weapon Cube increases Team DPS by up to 10%, so the more Cubes you collect the more damage you'll do. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/628b35d7cc114ae4a2a4f9e80b5745ca7f0c612c.png[/img]
[h1]Teammate Upgrade Effects[/h1]
We've limited how often the Teammate Upgrade Effects are displayed, increasing performance when Auto Buying after a Time Warp.
The Level Up effect will display every 5 seconds.
The Upgrade, Promote, Training & Spec Ops effects will display every 30 seconds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/0a27261742285f3d871ba4783d2a9b9d9183ac11.png[/img]
[h1]Modifiers Number Format[/h1]
When a number gets above 1 Million it starts using your selected Number Format.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/285f09c0d33532683dac98e07db6e7425a3dcd85.png[/img]
[h1]Chat[/h1]
Devs & Mods names will now show up in Yellow in chat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/50ef76178e021ea20b95d6a3fd27804431a547a4.png[/img]
[h1]Ghost Mode Renderer[/h1]
Now when on your Hover Bike you'll always see the character model whether you are in Ghost Mode or not. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/d2bde68edb57e2b01ff1b51979c5e2be9af0d330.png[/img]
[h1]Enemy Composition before Zone 10[/h1]
To make it feel more satisfying to fight enemies after grinding the early Zones, White Crawlers now start appearing before Zone 10.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/d154d76f5b1b29856db2ee203018af18f07a2f88.png[/img]
The Unlock Turret mission now requires you to defeat 275 enemies instead of 350 based on the new enemy composition. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/1aff938af98d6edbceda817111f96bc48db7570b.png[/img]
[h1]Boss Timer[/h1]
The Boss Timer has been fixed and will now count down from above 60 seconds. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/6afc4bd46c30da40c4ffa617288db6535c5681c8.png[/img]
[h1]Weapon Cubes[/h1]
Weapon Cubes spawn further from Time Cubes making them more satisfying to collect since they're easier to see.

[h1]Air Strike[/h1]
Fixed bug where Air Strike Energy was using banked energy after time warp. Now uses energy amount set in Research.

[list]
[*] Fix for Server Error causing Double Avatars on the Live Leaderboard
[*] Fixed getting Carry Capacity Warning even though Research was maxed
[*] Fixed Time Cube Achievements have been updated to say Time Cube Drop not Time Cube Find

A lot of the changes in this update were based on the suggestions in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discordapp.com/invite/N4G2mZ9]Discord [/url] Ideas channel. The next Friday Update will be on September 20.

[h1]Weapon Cube Outfit[/h1]
Unlock this Outfit by completing the 'Collect 1,000 Weapon Cubes' Mission.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/365ecb8bb99b2930c7e93fd227106d72ed09d5ba.png[/img]
[h1]Starting Gold Offset Research[/h1]
This new Time Cube & Weapon Cube Research sets what Zone your Starting Gold is based on.
For example, your Starting Gold Offset is 100 Zones, if your Start Zone is 41 your Starting Gold will be from Zone 141.
This lets you to start a run Overpowered.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/3d8177c903e9315d6146e41db74df6db82611803.png[/img]
[h1]Weapon Cube Research[/h1]
Spend Weapon Cubes to boost your Click Weapon, Drone & Turret Damage.
You can also boost the Gold & Rainbow Gold multipliers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/adac0f4d2a7c9d479f83483e28a0ad99ac32a80b.png[/img]
[h1]Autobuy[/h1]
To avoid deactivating Perks by Promoting too early, Autobuy waits until you can afford all 4 Upgrades before Promoting.
Since Training takes longer Autobuy will enter Training as soon as you can afford 2 Upgrades.

If you've invested in Drone & Turret Autobuy Research they will now automatically start leveling up after Time Warp.

Fixed the bug where Autobuy would sometimes buy higher than Start Gold after warping.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/94ebf9a4ad00ecad503c685e37a992544d15ee52.png[/img]
[h1]Gold Overpowered Bars[/h1]
The Gold Overpowered bars make it easier to tell if it's a good time to promote.
The bars have been separated into 2 rows, 1 above & 1 below the Perks making it easier to read.
The top row is for the current Promotion level. The dark yellow bars show which Perks you can afford to unlock, while the bright yellow bar shows if you can afford to Promote. 
The bottom row shows how many Upgrades you can afford after Promoting.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/9afaa4b1b8f5060f2b8e580e1aded82143f4f9b6.png[/img]
[h1]Weapon Cube Widget[/h1]
Click on the Time Cube or Weapon Cube icon to toggle between the Time Cube & Weapon Cube Widgets.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/c955044d57c782490915ef5f8bbf18931dc253fa.png[/img]
[h1]Weapon Cube Emoji[/h1]
Type weaponcube into the in-game chat for the Weapon Cube emoji.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/24ba0f34e10c5ff0e1821aff4b347bd851b1a3f2.png[/img]
[h1]Orbit Mode Zone Separator[/h1]
Orbit now has lines separating every 10 Zones.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/cb76a183ce3ce0b44971bb756ffc0518774066ae.png[/img]
[h1]Show Zone Complete Arrows[/h1]
New option to show/hide the Zone complete arrows in Settings > Graphics

[h1]Invincible Enemies[/h1]
Fixed the bug where enemies would occasionally spawn & be invincible.

[h1]Loading Improvements[/h1]
We've improved how the planets are loaded and stored in memory which means faster loading times & better overall performance.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Public World Players Online counter was changed from UDP to TCP
[*] Changed Air Strike Waves tooltip to say Wave instead of Level.
[*] Cleaned up the 'Spec Ops' Mission wording.
[/list]
A lot of the changes in this update were based on the Discord Ideas channel, so thanks for the great suggestions. The next Friday Update will be on August 23, in the meantime follow us on Steam to get update notifications & check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discordapp.com/invite/N4G2mZ9]Discord[/url]

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/951e9fddb94b9f6ad62dc41978e222fc591b5f9b.png[/img]
[h1]Weapon Cubes[/h1]
Weapon Cubes will start appearing at Zone 500, with guaranteed cubes every 500 Zones. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/95ae5a2a2446ca624dbbccc3fbfa0c92f8e0b97d.png[/img]
[h1]Air Strike[/h1]
Call in an Air Strike to do massive damage. 
Each Air Strike instantly deals 25%-100% damage to a Wave depending on how you've invested your Weapon Cubes. 
The Air Strike is perfect for when you're pushing through a deep run and need an extra burst of damage. 
Increase how many waves in a row the Air Strike will hit, just defeat the current wave in order to call in the next one. 
Spend Weapon Cubes to unlock this ability. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/d7856c69687a373f3fb5d21efd55453b358aa232.png[/img]
[h1]Dimension Shift[/h1]
A Time Clickers favorite, the Dimension Shift Ability increases all DPS for the duration of the run.
Use this ability multiple times in a run to stack damage and push further in deep runs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/47a1fec47e09fa8f55148d87408927f412095861.png[/img]
[h1]Autobuy[/h1]
The Start Level Research has been replaced with the new Autobuy system.
Autobuy automatically levels up your Click Weapon, Drone & Turret based on your Gold. 
As you earn more Gold it will continue to Autobuy team levels until you reach your max.
Autobuy will only Promote when you can afford all 4 Upgrades.
In case you don't want to have your teammates right away, after Time Warping you will need to click on the Drone & Turret 1 time each o buy those teammates before they will start Autobuying levels.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/e3f512ba233703bee06af8f576c7c31fadd90013.png[/img]
[h1]Starting Gold[/h1]
You will now start with 1 Wave worth of Gold based on your Starting Zone.
Autobuy will use the Starting Gold to automatically level up your team after Time Warping. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/d8b48d70ec7fa9d26d04db8a94d37fb6f9e99c6d.png[/img]
[h1]Weapon Cube Research Screen[/h1]
Spend Weapon Cubes to enhance Air Strike, Dimension Shift & Weapon Cube Progression.
You can also boost team Autobuy, Start Zone & Waves Per Zone Research. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/6aa266698c6a0e53983e7d5176301137b283bbcf.png[/img]

[h1]Join A Friend[/h1]
The 'Join Friend' button on the Main Menu shows all of your Steam friend's currently in a Co-Op World.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/cd2d05134e81f460236591c67ac759a600a25df4.png[/img]
[h1]Reset Research Preset[/h1]
We've had a lot of requests for the ability to completely respec a Research Preset, so we've added a 'Sell All' button when Time Warping. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/a307a6617de05c75b89aaaf74d9b9f22bac32113.png[/img]
You'll need to confirm the respec so you can't accidentally refund all of your Time Cubes. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/4b14e61bbd419a60313273e93d04460c4a4b721a.png[/img]
[h1]Devs & Mods[/h1]
Devs & Mods will now show up with a yellow outline on the Live Leaderboard & in the Convoy Widget.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/e6aa47ec3a0c8b3e9466d31e7da5f910ee0302a6.png[/img]

[h1]Networking[/h1]
Over the past few weeks the server has been like a giant game of whack-a-mole. 
We add logging to the server, find & fix a network bug, this increases the network traffic letting players further stress test the server, which uncovers a new bug, repeat. 

However its been a successful game of whack-a-mole, we've:
- Fixed an inconsistent timer that was causing group disconnects
- Resolved an issue where an already connected player reconnects to the server
- Tested out a new server host, but returned to our previous host due to better performance
- Fixed a few network errors

Based on our logs, the remaining server disconnects all seem to be valid, meaning the player has not communicated with the server in over 60 seconds. 

We'll continue to keep an eye on the server as the network traffic continues to increase. 

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed admin input field to password field
[*] Admin passwords saved, no longer have to re-type each time
[/list]

The next Friday Update will be on June 14, follow us on Steam to get update notifications & check out our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/N4G2mZ9]Discord[/url].

notes.title: UPDATE 14: Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/4232cb10e6bcddcbe4654daf651b236340572459.png[/img]
[h1]Female Outfit[/h1]

[h1]Updating to Unity 2019.1[/h1]
The newest game engine adds Experimental Incremental Garbage Collection. This means fewer lag spikes and smoother transitions between Zones.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/e2364489ab8d7c2ea2d7e91ad6c51fad4e54959b.png[/img]
When updating Unity there are always a few things that break. Time Cubes rendering incorrectly & corrupted button icons were just a couple of the bugs we encountered.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/3a01813fb2e028a7e6afa2301d0d413118ad457b.png[/img]
[h1]Cinemachine[/h1]
While updating our camera system, we decided it was a good time to improve the in-game cameras. It will now switch between a close up view of the Soldier & a zoomed out view showing all the action in the Zone. 

[h1]Network Library[/h1]
We found a multi-threading issue on the server that could cause disconnects, so we've updated the network library increasing server stability.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/74e3d810530ba1ea354bebc811db0eb55c85b4af.png[/img]
[h1]Hide Other Players Bullets[/h1]
One of our most requested performance enhancements, the ability to hide other players bullets. Even though you can't see their bullets, they will still cause damage.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/4dceb97db68cce48ea8e2289580b5b5ff3cc8093.png[/img]
The 'Show Other Players Bullets' option can be found in Settings > Graphics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/2b8640c245e051ca7211063d75eacee132bbb3a1.png[/img]
[h1]Time Warp Anytime[/h1]
After completing your first Time Warp, you can now Time Warp anytime whether you've collected Time Cubes or not.

[h1]Free Roam Camera Reset[/h1]
Based on your feedback, the Free Roam Camera now resets when leaving Horde/Big Boss Zone instead of after completing each Zone.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/c7891a585c5856c8d8d8c22a5aa7409fe8800ed0.png[/img]
[h1]Fullscreen 4K Resolution[/h1]
For best performance the default maximum resolution is 1080p. The 'Fullscreen 4K Resolution' option increases display quality for players with higher resolution monitors. This option can be found in Settings > Display.

[h1]IL2CPP[/h1]
We implemented an IL2CPP optimization but as described below we ended up with some unexpected results.

[b]Mono[/b]: With the default Mono backend, as you encounter a new piece of code while playing, it gets compiled to machine code, which in theory can cause lag spikes.
[b]IL2CPP[/b]: All code is pre-compiled to machine code. Compiling in the editor takes longer, but the produced code is supposed to be faster.

Mono Lowest FPS = 91
IL2CPP Lowest FPS = 61
So IL2CPP was actually worse when spawning enemies. This is why measuring optimizations is important. 

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed losing cursor when in Free Roam Camera & getting on/off Hover Bike
[*] Potential fix for invincible enemies 
[*] Weapon switching optimizations
[*] Moderators have the ability to Mute players in Global Chat
[*] Updated Hover Bike icon
[*] Fixed Pick Up System Null Reference Error
[/list]

The next Friday Update will be on May 17, in the meantime share your feedback on the Steam Forums & our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/N4G2mZ9]Discord[/url].

notes.title: UPDATE 10: Overpowered!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637666/f55bd2df80a5e220e66ca41761b3b3365b68f607.png[/img]

Overpowered kicks in as soon as you are e7 times stronger than a Zone, but you'll need to be e17 times stronger to be 100% Overpowered. 

The more Overpowered you are the more damage you'll do, instantly destroying a wave of enemies when you're 100% Overpowered.

You'll also move faster, doubling your movement & Hover Bike speed when you're 100% Overpowered. 

While Overpowered, undefeated bosses will automatically spawn & you will instantly teleport to the next planet after beating the End of Planet boss. 

If Convoy Lock is turned on while Overpowered you'll still get the damage boost but it will ignore the Overpowered speed boost.

This sprint was all about performance optimizations. Our main focus was on implementing Unity's experimental ECS technology, which is designed to take advantage of multicore processors, high performance code & optimized memory layouts.

Some ways we've been able to take advantage of this new system are:
[list]
[*] More projectiles & gold pickups with even better performance
[*] Consumes less memory with significantly fewer lag spikes
[*] Faster streaming of Zone details (like border lights)
[/list]
This was a top request from a lot of players, so let us know what you think of the performance improvements.
